question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left winger, Bob is playing fullback, Claire is playing right midfielder, Dave is playing left back, Eve is playing right winger, Fred is playing sweeper, and Gertrude is playing goalkeeper.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Eve and Bob trade positions. Then, Claire and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Alice and Fred trade positions. Then, Fred and Alice trade positions. Then, Dave and Claire trade positions. Then, Alice and Gertrude trade positions. Finally, Alice and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Eve is playing
Options:
(A) left winger
(B) fullback
(C) right midfielder
(D) left back
(E) right winger
(F) sweeper
(G) goalkeeper
solution:
Positions in player order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude):
Initial: (left winger, fullback, right midfielder, left back, right winger, sweeper, goalkeeper)
1. Eve ↔ Bob: (left winger, right winger, right midfielder, left back, fullback, sweeper, goalkeeper)
2. Claire ↔ Gertrude: (left winger, right winger, goalkeeper, left back, fullback, sweeper, right midfielder)
3. Alice ↔ Fred: (sweeper, right winger, goalkeeper, left back, fullback, left winger, right midfielder)
4. Fred ↔ Alice: (left winger, right winger, goalkeeper, left back, fullback, sweeper, right midfielder)
5. Dave ↔ Claire: (left winger, right winger, left back, goalkeeper, fullback, sweeper, right midfielder)
6. Alice ↔ Gertrude: (right midfielder, right winger, left back, goalkeeper, fullback, sweeper, left winger)
7. Alice ↔ Claire: (left back, right winger, right midfielder, goalkeeper, fullback, sweeper, left winger)
Eve is playing fullback, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
